turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
I don't think this is productive.
Productive. My son found out from his phone, in class. Was he heard first, yes or no?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
Then I'm walking to the principal's office from here, Hale. Yes or no, before you go.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.
I'll do more than email. Before you walk out, is anything on his record right now?
